shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
for f in lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx next.config.ts; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done; git diff package.json

grep -o 'Premium Widget' .next/server/app/product.html | head -1; grep -o 'Loading inventory' .next/server/app/product.html | head -1; grep -c 'in stock' .next/server/app/product.html; echo ---; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json
cat .gitignore; git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short
